address.lookup_rule: BLAKE2b-256("pigeonservice-v1-lookup" || 0x00 || id || u64be(period)), period = unix time / 86400; a directory takes the periods either side of its own
address.rule: base32(version || id || checksum), RFC 4648 lower case without padding; id = BLAKE2b-256(public key); checksum = BLAKE2b-256("pigeonservice address checksum" || version || id)[..2]

identity.seed_rule: Falcon key generator seed (32 B, falcon-rs SHAKE256 PRNG) || Ed25519 seed (32 B)

records.framing: a 4-byte big-endian length, then the CBOR, split over as many connection messages as it takes

refused.case: a Renew's signature on a Register
signed for the directory, sent to the router
the first again: a retransmission, answered as before

refused_records.case: a listing signed by another key

scheme.falcon_signing: deterministic in this crate: the Falcon reference PRNG seeded with SHAKE256("pigeonservice-v1 falcon sign" || Falcon private key || signed message); any valid Falcon signature verifies
scheme.hybrid: public key = Falcon-padded-512 (897 B) || Ed25519 (32 B); signature = Falcon-padded-512 (666 B) || Ed25519 (64 B), both over the signed message, both must verify (hpqc hybrid.FalconPadded512Ed25519)
scheme.name: Falcon-padded-512-Ed25519
scheme.signed_message: "pigeonservice-v1-sig" || 0x00 || ctx || 0x00 || canonical CBOR of the message without Signature
